notes.title: It's Time to SWITCH Things Up and Get Ready for the MAC Version
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006151/ecc61d2a4f1dc5f2465c3ffa09216f369a74b273.png"]The time has come, boys and girls; The moment that at least a handful of you have been waiting for…

The Edge of Allegoria is now available on the Nintendo Switch!!!

That right, this little green game has finally found its way onto the great-great-great-great grandchild of the console that inspired it in the first place, and it has never been more at home. Sure, the Steam Deck is a joy to play on (not to mention the Verified check matches the green palette perfectly), but you gotta admit, there’s something deeply satisfying about seeing THIS GAME on your Switch home screen next to the plumber brothers and that sparky yellow rat.

ALSO!

The moment that a slightly smaller handful of you have been waiting for is also coming soon! That’s right Mac users, soon you’ll be able to join in on all the fun and experience all the raucous excitement and wonder you’ve been missing out on all this time. There’s still some work that needs to be done before this Granny Smith of a game shows up on your Apple computer, but you can expect it to be ready to harvest before the end of the year! Until then, I’m sure you can keep yourselves busy being better than everyone else.

notes.title: The Edge of Allegoria Release Day!!!
notes.notes:
Greetings kiddos,

Do you feel the buzz in the air? Hear the cheers, the clash of swords, and the mischievous chuckles in the distance?
That’s right—The Edge of Allegoria is out NOW!

Step into a dark, retro-inspired world filled with secrets, thrilling battles, and stories that’ll make you laugh, cry, and maybe question your sanity. It’s all served with a generous side of dark humor and just the right amount of chaos—welcome to Allegoria.

So, tell your friends, your pets, your neighbors (or don’t, we’re not picky). And if you’re the one watching someone through the window—stop lurking and start playing!

Join our Discord, share your wildest moments with the community, and dive into The Edge of Allegoria—where the madness begins today. 🔥

notes.title: One day before release!
notes.notes:
Greetings kiddo, 

do you feel the rumbling in the distance? Can you hear the ecstatic screams of thousands of people? 
Can you taste the spiciness? 
Probably not, because you're just reading a text on Steam - so yeah, the Edge of Allegoria will be released tomorrow, so be ready to jump into a world full of secrets, epic fights, interesting stories, and a big portion of retro-charm mixed with dark humor! 

Tell your friends, your mom, your dog, and the one dude starring at you through the window :) 

Join our Discord to share your experience with the whole community and be ready to enjoy your time in Allegoria! 

P.S.: Watch out for our launch trailer, this one is going to be special....
